Coforge Chairman OP Bhatt Resigns Amid Audit Review

Coforge Chairman O.P. Bhatt has resigned from his position following a review of an internal audit. The company stated that Bhatt's resignation would not impact its operations or financial performance. Coforge shares saw a decline following the announcement of his departure. The resignation comes after questions were raised concerning a board evaluation report.
